### ⚠️ Requires [Eggolib](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/) to be installed! ⚠️

## Is Piglin Safe

---


[__Dimension Type Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/dimension_type_condition_types/is_piglin_safe)

Checks if the dimension do not zombify and shake Piglins and Hoglins.

Type ID: `eggolib:is_piglin_safe`

---

### Examples

=== "Example #1"

    ``` json
    "dimension_type_condition": {
        "type": "eggolib:is_piglin_safe"
    }
    ```



[1]: ../dimension_type_condition_types.md
